result.topic_en: A bibliographic note on Poggendorff's Annalen der Physik und Chemie (volumes 70–74, supplementary volume 1, third series volumes 10–14), together with calculations of an exponential integral of the form $\int e^{-(sp+q/s)}$ that are reduced by substitution to integrals involving $\sqrt{s^2-pq}$.

methods.what: Exponential integral of the form $\int e^{sp+q/s}$ with lower limit $\alpha$
Completing the square in the exponent: $sp+q/s=(\sqrt{sp}+\sqrt{q/s})^2-2\sqrt{pq}$
Inverting the substitution by solving a quadratic for the variable
Reduction to a Gaussian-type integral with lower limit $\sqrt{\alpha p}+\sqrt{q/\alpha}$
Substitution giving an integral with an algebraic kernel
